blocks.text: Fidélium, Deus, ómnium Cónditor et Redémptor: animábus famulórum famu larúmque tuárum remissiónem cunctórum tríbue peccatórum; ut indulgéntiam, quam semper optavérunt, piis supplicatiónibus consequántur: Per Dominum...
blocks.translation: O God, Creator and Redeemer of all the faithful, grant to the souls of Your servants and hand­maids the remission of all their sins, that they may obtain by our loving prayers the forgiveness which they have always desired. Through Our Lord...

blocks.text: All sit

blocks.chantTranslation:
Grant them eternal rest,//O Lord,
and let perpetual light//shine upon them.


May their souls//dwell in prosperity,


and may their descendants//inherit the earth.

Absolve, O Lord, the souls//of all the faithful departed
from every bond of sin.

And, with the help//of your grace,
may they deserve
to escape the judgment//of punishment.

And enjoy the blessedness//of everlasting light.

Day of wrath, that day will//dissolve the world//into ashes,
as David and the Sibyl//bear witness.
What trembling//there shall be,//when the Judge shall come,
to examine//all things strictly!
The trumpet, scattering//its wondrous sound//through the tombs
of every land,//shall summon all//before the throne.
Death and nature//shall stand amazed,//when creation rises again
to answer to the Judge.//The written book//shall be brought forth,
in which all things//are contained, from which//the world shall be judged.
When therefore//the Judge shall sit,//whatever is hidden
shall appear: nothing//shall remain unpunished.
What then shall I,//wretched man, say?//What advocate shall I seek,
when even the righteous//scarcely stand secure?
King of dreadful majesty,//who freely save those
worthy of salvation,//save me,//O fountain of mercy.
Remember, loving Jesus,//that I am the reason
for your earthly journey://do not lose me on that day.
Seeking me,//you sat down weary;
suffering the Cross,//you redeemed me:
let such labour//not be in vain.
Just Judge of vengeance,//grant the gift of pardon
before the day//of reckoning.
I groan as one guilty;//my face reddens with shame//for my sins:
spare your suppliant,//O God.//You who absolved Mary,
and heard the thief,//have given hope to me also.
My prayers are not worthy://but you, who are good,
deal kindly with me,//lest I burn//in everlasting fire.
Grant me a place//among the sheep,
and separate me//from the goats,
setting me//at your right hand.
When the accursed//have been confounded,
and consigned//to bitter flames,
call me among the blessed.//I pray, bowed down//in supplication,
my heart crushed as ashes://take care of my final end.
That day//shall be one of tears,
when guilty man//shall rise from the ashes//to be judged.
Therefore spare him,//O God:
merciful Lord Jesus,//grant them rest.//Amen.

blocks.text:
Dómine Iesu Christe, Rex glóriæ, líbera ánimas ómnium fidélium defunctórum de pœnis inférni et de profúndo lacu: líbera eas de ore leónis, ne absórbeat eas tártarus, ne cadant in obscúrum: sed sígnifer sanctus Míchaël repræséntet eas in lucem sanctam: Quam olim Abrahæ promisísti et sémini eius.

Hóstias et preces tibi, Dómine, laudis offérimus: tu súscipe pro animábus illis, quarum hódie memóriam fácimus: fac eas, Dómine, de morte transíre ad vitam. Quam olim Abrahæ promisísti et sémini eius.
blocks.translation:
Lord Jesus Christ, King of glory, deliver the souls of all the faithful departed from the pains of hell and from the deep pit; deliver them from the lion’s mouth, lest Tartarus swallow them up, lest they fall into darkness: but may the standard-bearer, holy Michael, bring them into the holy light, which you once promised to Abraham and his seed.

We offer you, O Lord, sacrifices and prayers of praise: receive them for those souls whom we remember this day; grant, O Lord, that they may pass from death into life, which you once promised to Abraham and his seed.

blocks.text: Hóstias, quǽsumus, Dómine, quas tibi pro animábus famulórum famularúmque tuárum offérimus, propitiátus inténde: ut, qui bus fídei christiánæ méritum contulísti, dones et prǽmium. Per Dominum...
blocks.translation: Look with mercy, we beseech You, O Lord, upon the sacrificial gifts we offer for the souls of Your servants and handmaids, so that, to those upon whom You conferred the merits of Christian faith, You will also grant its reward. Through Our Lord...

blocks.text: \V. Panem cæléstem accípiam, et nomen Dómini invocábo.
blocks.translation: \V. I will take the Bread of heaven, and will call upon the Name of the Lord.

blocks.text: \R. Dómine, non sum dignus, ut intres sub tectum meum: sed tantum dic verbo, et sanábitur ánima mea.
blocks.translation: \R. Lord, I am not worthy that Thou shouldst enter under my roof; say but the word, and my soul shall be healed.

blocks.text: Lux ætérna lúceat eis, Dómine, Cum Sanctis tuis in ætérnum: quia pius es. Requiem ætérnam dona eis, Dómine: et lux perpétua lúceat eis. Cum Sanctis tuis in ætérnum: quia pius es.
blocks.translation: May eternal light shine upon them, O Lord: * with your saints for ever, because you are merciful. Grant them eternal rest, O Lord: * and let perpetual light shine upon them. With your saints for ever: * because you are merciful.

blocks.text: Pater peccávi in cælum et coram te. Iam non sum dignus vocári fílius tuus.
blocks.translation: And the son said unto him, Father, I have sinned against heaven, and in thy sight, and am no more worthy to be called thy son.

blocks.chantTranslation:

blocks.text: Animábus, quǽsumus, Dómine, famulórum famularúmque tuárum orátio profíciat supplicántium: ut eas et a peccátis ómnibus éxuas, et tuæ redemptiónis fácias esse partícipes: Per Dominum...
blocks.translation: May the prayer of Your suppliants, O Lord, benefit the souls of Your servants and handmaids, that You may deliver them from all sins and make them sharers in Your redemption. Through Our Lord...

blocks.text: Audivi vocem de cælo, dicentem mihi: Beati mortui qui in Domino moriuntur.
blocks.translation: I heard a voice from heaven, saying unto me: Blessed are the dead which die in the Lord.
